Getting Started: Systems, Properties & Pressure

Every problem gets fresh numbers each time you press New numbers. Set it up the ES 305 way — Known, Find, Schematic, Assumptions, Properties — then check your answers and open the Analysis.

Key ideas: systems, properties, pressure

System & boundary

Draw the boundary first. Closed system: fixed mass, energy crosses. Control volume: mass crosses too. Everything outside is the surroundings.

Pressure

Gages read relative to the atmosphere. Tables and equations of state need absolute pressure.

Piston equilibrium

Free-body diagram of the piston: ΣF = 0 when it moves slowly (quasi-equilibrium).

Manometer

The column height L converts to pressure through ρg. Watch units: lbm·ft/s² needs g_c = 32.174 lbm·ft/(lbf·s²).

Units to memorize

1 bar = 100 kPa = 10⁵ Pa · 1 atm = 101.325 kPa = 14.696 psi · 1 lbf/in² × 144 = lbf/ft² · 1 lbf = 32.174 lbm·ft/s².
